Collection: Contemporary Art Books

Louis Fratino: Satura

By Louis Fratino (Artist)

Published by: Mousse Publishing

Location: Milan, Italy

Date: February 11, 2025

Language: English

Format: Paperback, 144 pages, Illustrated (color)

Dimensions: 13.5 x 10.75 inches (34 x 27 cm)

ISBN-13: 978-8867496563

ISBN-10: 8867496565

Contributors: Stefano Collicelli Cagol (Editor), Evan Moffitt, Raven Schlossberg, Jeremy Sorese, John Belknap (Photographer)

LC Call No.: ND237.F73 A4 2025

Added: April 18, 2025

Summary

This first monograph dedicated to the American painter Louis Fratino (born 1993) explores the artist's multifaceted practice spanning painting, drawing, and sculpture.

It focuses on his distinctive representation of male intimacy, everyday life, and contemporary queer identity.

The publication features critical essays and contributions that delve into Fratino's technique, art historical influences, and key thematic concerns within his work.
